name: diagram-tools
description: Default, polished offline Mermaid rendering with editable source and a contract-gated runtime.

interface.longDescription: Diagram Tools is the default Mermaid renderer, preserving editable source and producing self-contained SVG, real PNG, or terminal-friendly ASCII through a tested offline runtime while routing advanced native draw.io work separately.
defaultPrompt: Use $pretty-mermaid by default for Mermaid diagrams and export editable source with polished SVG or PNG.
Render these Mermaid sources as terminal-friendly ASCII.
